summary: NOVONIX Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX Appendix 3H notification dated September 18, 2026, disclosing the cessation of 460,452 unquoted performance rights (code NVXAD) on September 18, 2026. The lapse occurred because the conditional vesting conditions were not, or became incapable of being, satisfied, and the filing attributes it to lapse of employee performance rights on cessation of employment; no consideration is payable. Following the change, 997,852,692 ordinary shares remain on issue, alongside remaining unquoted performance rights, options, share rights, convertible notes and convertible debentures. This is a routine equity administration notice, not a special situation.
